title: Open mathematical Olympiad for University Students
text:
Open Mathematical Olympiad for University Students (OMOUS)

Organizer: International University for the Humanities and Development, Ashgabat, Turkmenistan.

The Olympiad is intended for university students who are interested in mathematics.

The official language of the Olympiad is English.

The Olympiad conducted in the form of individual and team competition.

- individual competition will have two Categories: A and B.

Category A is for students majoring in Mathematics and Computer Science.

Category B is for students of other majors, where they will be given 6 problems and four hours (240 minutes) to solve them. - a group of at most 4 students can participate in the group competition regardless of their majors, where teams will be given 10 problems and two hours (120 minutes) to solve them.

Each of the participating universities can nominate several students who will take part in the Olympiad. There is not any particular restriction on the number of nominees.
